query: WITH ActiveEstablishments AS ( SELECT TRIM(employer_name) AS employer_name, COUNT(*) AS employee_count,         AVG(total_wage) AS avg_wage       FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala     WHERE is_active_job = 1     AND total_wage BETWEEN 100 AND 600000     GROUP BY TRIM(employer_name)     HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) SELECT      employer_name,             employee_count,             avg_wage  FROM ActiveEstablishments  ORDER BY avg_wage DESC  LIMIT 10;
